name: Padraic McKinley
bio: Padraic McKinley (born 1974) is an American producer, editor, and director, best known for his directorial debut The Weight (2026), as well as executive producer roles on television series such as The Good Lord Bird and The Loudest Voice. He is set to direct the third film in the Sicario franchise.
